activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the space heater off and the room dark
Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and taking a warm shower
Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, then washing up
Getting dressed, packing a bag with a sketchbook and laptop
Commuting to the arts organization office on public transport
Working as an arts administrator at the office: meetings, grant paperwork and program coordination
Taking a lunch break and eating near the office
Continuing administrative work and reviewing exhibition schedules at the office
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
Relaxing on the sofa, watching a short TV program
Working on freelance illustrations on the computer with the monitor and desk lamp on
Night routine: washing face, brushing teeth and preparing for bed
